role: release-engineering-author audit of previously independently reviewed artifact; not fresh whole-algorithm independent approval
findings: The retained v2 sets lock_release_started before any release and never automatically swaps App paths again after that boundary.
Before release, App-only rollback keeps both existing data locks; rollback and original failure evidence are both retained.
A stopped/pending record after release requires fresh process, lock and App identity inspection before recovery.
Current data/UNKNOWN/media/Feedback/defaults must not be overwritten from a pre-upgrade backup for an App rollback.
Source/package/backup/CI pins and complete app file and mode identities remain separate requirements.
